Heads up folks，Amazon just dropped price on base model M6 Mac mini down to $879.99 shipped。That's not a giant discount or anything but it is less than buying one straight from Apple and the first price drop yet。

Amazon is now offering base model M6 Mac mini Apple just unveiled down at $879.99 shipped。You're looking at most affordable 16GB/256GB configuration there。

iPhone 17 Pro just hit best price ever via Amazon up to $285 off（Premium Renewed）

Just ahead of iPhone 18 Pro launch，Amazon is now delivering new all-time lows on iPhone 17 Pro。If you're looking to side step full and likely very expensive price on new Pro models next month，or wait for them to hit refurbished shelves for another 6+ months，Amazon best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are now $285 off and with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee。

As of right now，proper Amazon Renewed Premium listings are very best place to score a deal on iPhone 17 Pro。Apple still does not even carry them in its refurbished store，and we are talking about best quality units Amazon carries with full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and「greater than 90% original battery life」— these are not your typical refurbished units。

Both 512GB and 1TB models are now sitting at lowest prices we have ever tracked：

  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,171（Reg. $1,299 new）— all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,170（Reg. $1,299 new）— all-time low

All of links above will take you to proper Amazon Renewed Premium listings — watch out for those third-party sellers。

I don't know about you，but I'm really going to miss 17 Pro colorways，as much as I did want to see an all black model，and I might very well be holding on to mine for another year。

Anker MagSafe Nano Power Bank is one of best，drops to one of lowest prices of year at $49（All colors）

Anker latest Nano Power Bank is easily among most compelling options out there when it comes to price and form-factor for those just looking for quick top ups on go。Regularly $60 these days，you can now land one down at $49.50，or within $5 or so of lowest price ever。

Official Amazon Anker store is now offering its Nano MagSafe Power Bank down at $49.49 shipped。

This is an Amazon Lightning deal and select colors are also close to 50% sold out at discounted rate。

Now carrying a $60 list price after launching at $55，this is nearly 20% off and lowest price we can find。While it might not seem like a giant deal，this has been a relatively popular model and it is now within roughly $5 of Prime Day 2026 all-time low。

This model has a few things going for it。You're not looking at one of those chunky 10K mAh models here，but rather a more sleek and transportable option for quick top ups while away from an outlet。It also comes in six different colors，from vibrant orange and black，through to softer blues、whites、and even a light gold colorway。

Qi2-certified one is regularly found on best of lists as an alternative to Apple iPhone Air Battery，but it can be used on all of latest and previous-generation phones with magnetic and Qi2 action。

Amazon is still offering AirPods Pro 3 at nearly $50 off right now

Deal pricing at most retailers on latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3 has gone up now，but you can still land a set at $50 off via Amazon right now。

Amazon is currently offering Apple flagship buds down at $199.99 shipped to deliver lowest price around in brand new condition。

We did just recently get a shot to score them for $10 less there，but if you didn't get a chance to pull trigger and are still looking to land a set，there is still some savings up for grabs。

All things considered，save for Prime Day offer and two other chances，today's price is on par with lowest we have tracked since release in September。

It is also worth pointing out that at this point it does not look like a new set of AirPods Pro 4 are landing next month。Most projections、analysts、and rumors have Apple releasing new base model AirPods 5 and not a new pro set this year，so current AirPods Pro 3 will remain a current-generation investment into 2027。And with rumors of camera tech landing on next-gen set，there's no telling how much they will release at。

Regularly $80，this is nearly 40% off list price and within just $10 of best deal we have ever tracked — it dropped to $40 once since release during June Prime event。

This might very well be more than enough for most folks with its Retinal 2K video、up to 6x Enhanced Zoom、ability to「see、hear、and speak in real time with Live View and Two-Way Talk,」and real-time notifications on your phone when motion is detected。But if you're looking to take it up a notch with 4K action，we are still tracking a price drop on 4K Pro model：

  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $200（Reg. $250）

These units feature up to 10x Enhanced Zoom、night vision、and Retinal 4K with wide-angle video alongside a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for re-charging on the wireless battery model。
